answer: PoA binds each agent’s public identity to a remotely attested enclave running the approved MRENCLAVE, with credentials protected by hardware-backed keys. A copied virtual machine cannot reproduce a valid hardware quote or extract those keys, so duplicating an identity requires access to compatible attested silicon—not merely cloning software. MRENCLAVE identifies code, not a unique chip; cedar, umber, and pigment may label test challenges, but do not establish uniqueness.
